varieties.name: Tylka F1
varieties.supplier_notes: Hybrid; widely available at Elgon Kenya, ETG, Juanco SPS

varieties.name: Cal-J
varieties.supplier_notes: Open-pollinated; lower input cost; good for fresh-market

timeline_template.description_en: Sow seeds in nursery trays with sterile coco peat. Cover lightly with media.
timeline_template.description_sw: Panda mbegu kwenye trei za kitalu na coco peat safi. Funika kidogo na udongo.
timeline_template.tip_en: Pre-soak seed for 4 hours in warm water for faster germination.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Loweka mbegu maji moto kwa saa 4 kabla ya kupanda kwa kuotesha haraka.

timeline_template.description_en: Check germination at day 7-10. Expect 80%+ germination from quality F1 seed.
timeline_template.description_sw: Angalia kuotesha siku ya 7-10. Tarajia asilimia 80+ ya mbegu kuotesha.

timeline_template.description_en: Gradually reduce watering and expose seedlings to direct sun for 5-7 days.
timeline_template.description_sw: Punguza maji polepole na peleka miche jua kwa siku 5-7.
Pandikiza miche ya wiki 4-6 kwa nafasi ya 60cm × 60cm.
timeline_template.tip_en: Transplant in late afternoon to reduce transplant shock.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Pandikiza alasiri kupunguza mshtuko wa kupandikizwa.

timeline_template.description_en: Apply 50kg DAP at planting (one tablespoon per planting hole).
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka kilo 50 za DAP wakati wa kupanda (kijiko kimoja kwa shimo).

timeline_template.description_en: Hand-weed or shallow-hoe between rows. Mulch with dry grass to suppress regrowth.
timeline_template.description_sw: Palia kwa mkono au jembe la juu juu. Funika na nyasi kavu kuzuia ukuaji wa magugu.

timeline_template.description_en: Apply 50kg CAN as side-dressing 15cm from plant base.
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka kilo 50 za CAN cm 15 kutoka kwa mmea.

timeline_template.description_en: Stake indeterminate varieties with 2m bamboo. Tie loosely with sisal twine.
timeline_template.description_sw: Simika nguzo za mianzi mita 2 kwa aina za mizizi mirefu. Funga kwa kamba ya katani.

timeline_template.description_en: Preventive fungicide spray (Ridomil Gold or equivalent PCPB-registered).
timeline_template.description_sw: Nyunyuza dawa ya kuzuia magonjwa (Ridomil Gold au mbadala iliyosajiliwa PCPB).

timeline_template.description_en: Apply second 50kg CAN dose as side-dressing.
First harvest pick. Pick fruits at breaker stage (turning red) for best shelf life.
timeline_template.description_sw: Mavuno ya kwanza. Chuna matunda yanayoanza kupauka kwa muda mrefu wa kuhifadhi.
timeline_template.tip_en: Harvest every 7-10 days. Expect 8-12 picks per season.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Vuna kila siku 7-10. Tarajia mavuno 8-12 kwa msimu.

post_harvest.grading_criteria: Grade A: firm, no blemishes, uniform red. Grade B: minor blemishes, slight softness. Grade C: ripe with imperfections — sell same day.
post_harvest.packaging_standard: 15kg crates (Kenya market standard); 25kg crates for processor delivery.
post_harvest.storage_tips_en: Store at room temperature 18-22°C. Avoid refrigeration above 12°C — chilling injury.
post_harvest.storage_tips_sw: Hifadhi joto la kawaida la nyumba 18-22°C. Epuka friji juu ya 12°C — huharibika kwa baridi.

diseases.symptoms_en: Target-ring brown spots on OLDER leaves first, yellowing, dark lesions near the fruit stem.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa ya kahawia yenye pete kwenye majani MAKUBWA kwanza, kuwitikia, vidonda karibu na shina la tunda.
diseases.treatment_en: Mancozeb-class (e.g. Dithane M-45) or Ridomil Gold alternating with a copper product, every 7-10 days from first sign. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa za mancozeb au Ridomil Gold kwa kubadilishana na dawa ya copper, kila siku 7-10 kuanzia inapoanza. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Stake and prune for airflow, rotate away from potato/pepper, avoid evening watering.
diseases.prevention_sw: Weka vimo na kata matawi kwa hewa, zungusha mbali na viazi/pilipili, epuka kumwagilia jioni.
diseases.scanner_notes: Rings on OLDER leaves, no white fuzz — the discriminator vs late blight.

diseases.severity_classes: Low (first spots) · High (field collapse in ~10 days)
diseases.symptoms_en: Water-soaked spots browning fast, white fuzz at lesion margins in humidity, blackened stems, fruit rot.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa yaliyolowa yanageuka kahawia haraka, ukungu mweupe kwenye kingo unyevu, mashina meusi, matunda kuoza.
diseases.treatment_en: Metalaxyl-class (Ridomil Gold) within 24h of detection; preventive schedule in cool wet weather. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa za metalaxyl (Ridomil Gold) ndani ya saa 24; ratiba ya kinga wakati wa baridi na mvua. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Certified seed, wide spacing, preventive spraying in wet spells, no overhead irrigation.
diseases.prevention_sw: Mbegu zilizothibitishwa, nafasi ya kutosha, dawa za kinga mvua nyingi, usimwagilie kutoka juu.
diseases.scanner_notes: White fuzz in humidity + fast spread = late blight. The fastest killer — escalate in-app.

diseases.symptoms_en: Green wilt of one side or branch, no recovery, milky ooze from a cut stem pressed in water.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Kunyauka kwa kijani upande mmoja, hakuna kupona, ute mweupe kutoka shina lililokatwa.
diseases.treatment_en: None — rogue and destroy infected plants; 3-season rotation away from solanaceous crops. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba — ng'oa na uteketeze; zungusha mashamba misimu 3 mbali na mimea ya solanaceous. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Certified seed, clean tools, avoid flooding and reused nursery soil.
diseases.prevention_sw: Mbegu zilizothibitishwa, vifaa safi, epuka mafuriko na udongo wa kitalu uliotumiwa.
diseases.scanner_notes: Cut-stem ooze test is the verification — photograph the cut stem.

diseases.severity_classes: Low (leaf mines) · High (fruit punctures, market loss)
diseases.symptoms_en: Silvery blotch mines on leaves, pin-prick holes on green fruit, distorted growth.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Michirizi ya fedha kwenye majani, mashimo madogo kwenye matunda mabichi, ukuaji uliopinda.
diseases.treatment_en: Chlorantraniliprole-class (Coragen 20 SC) at first mines; mass trapping complements sprays. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa za chlorantraniliprole (Coragen 20 SC) mara michirizi inapoanza; mitego inasaidia. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Pheromone traps, nursery netting, remove infested leaves and fallen fruit.
diseases.prevention_sw: Mitego ya pheromone, vifuniko vya kitalu, ondoa majani yaliyoathirika na matunda yaliyoanguka.
diseases.scanner_notes: Mines on leaves + pin-pricks on fruit together = Tuta. Leaf photo + fruit close-up.

diseases.symptoms_en: Upward curling yellow leaves, stunted plants, flower drop, whiteflies present.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Majani yanayojikunja juu na kuwitikia, mimea dhaifu, maua kuanguka, nzi weupe wapo.
diseases.treatment_en: None for the virus — Imidacloprid-class (Confidor 200 SL) targets the whitefly vector; rogue infected plants. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba ya virusi — dawa za imidacloprid (Confidor 200 SL) hudhibiti nzi weupe; ng'oa mimea iliyoathirika. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Plant TYLCV-resistant varieties (Tylka F1), whitefly control from the nursery, remove infected plants early.
diseases.prevention_sw: Panda aina sugu (Tylka F1), dhibiti nzi weupe kuanzia kitalu, ondoa mimea iliyoathirika mapema.
diseases.scanner_notes: Upward curl + yellowing + whiteflies = TYLCV, not nutrient deficiency (interveinal).

diseases.symptoms_en: One-sided yellowing of lower leaves, brown vascular ring in a cut stem, wilt despite watering.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Kuwitikia kwa upande mmoja wa majani ya chini, pete ya kahawia kwenye shina lililokatwa, kunyauka hata kwa kumwagilia.
diseases.treatment_en: None — rogue and destroy; resistant varieties (F1 hybrids with VFN resistance) and long rotation. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba — ng'oa na uteketeze; aina sugu (F1 zenye upinzani wa VFN) na kuzungusha kwa muda mrefu. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Rotation away from solanaceous crops, solarize beds where present, clean seed.
diseases.prevention_sw: Zungusha mbali na solanaceous, weka jua kwenye vitanda vilivyoathirika, mbegu safi.
diseases.scanner_notes: Cut-stem brown ring vs bacterial wilt's ooze — the two wilts need different photos.

market_notes.sell_windows_en: Prices peak in the dry spells when field supply thins (Jan-Mar, Aug-Oct); greenhouse growers capture the off-season premium. Grade by size, colour and blemish — the top grade sells to supermarkets and processors.
market_notes.sell_windows_sw: Bei hupanda kiangazi wakati mazao ya shambani yanapungua (Jan-Mar, Ago-Okt); wakulima wa greenhouses hunufaika na bei ya nje ya msimu. Panga daraja kwa ukubwa, rangi na usafi.
market_notes.price_notes_en: Open-field ~30-100 KES per kg by season and grade (November 2026). The tomato is the highest-volume vegetable in the Kenyan market — the disease plan, not the yield plan, decides the profit.
market_notes.price_notes_sw: Shambani ~KES 30-100 kwa kilo kwa msimu na daraja (Novemba 2026). Nyanya ni mboga yenye soko kubwa zaidi Kenya — mpango wa magonjwa, si wa mavuno, ndio unaoamua faida.
